title: automation: an approval node's escalation values are checked only at execution — timeoutHours 0.5 registers and activates, then every run fails and the record is created with no approval gate
body:
QA-source: #21845 · approvals.sla-escalation · outside the item's clauses

Found in the follow-up run #21845 (subject `316be321e`) and reproduced by an independent verifier (RUNNER rule 7) through a second door (an authored package): medium, predates 17.6.0.

## Reproduction

1. Register (admin `POST /api/v1/automation`, or ship in a package) an active record-triggered flow whose approval node has `escalation {enabled:true, timeoutHours:0.5, action:'notify'}` → 200 / loaded `active`.
2. Create a record that matches the trigger → 201.

- Expected: registration refuses the value (the schema says `timeoutHours >= 1`).
- Actual: every trigger-fired run fails with `Approval node 'gate' has invalid config: escalation.timeoutHours: Too small…`; no approval request opens; the record exists without the gate and the user sees nothing.

## Mechanism

`packages/services/service-automation/src/engine.ts` (~10425-10480) checks only undeclared config **key names** at registration; values are parsed only at execute (`packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-node.ts:133` against `approval.zod.ts:666`).

## Done when

Registration (and package load) runs the node's full config schema and refuses invalid values with a located error; a test covers the 0.5-hour case.
